# A snowy pine 2.6 m tall: a plum trunk, three coral 7-sided tiers, a cream snow cap on each.
# Origin on the ground under the trunk. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.486 0.247 0.345 --no-slot
material new Needles --base-color 0.922 0.420 0.435 --no-slot
material new Snow --base-color 1.000 0.965 0.827 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.17 --depth 0.6 --location 0 0 0.3
material assign Bark
add mesh cone --name Low --vertices 7 --radius1 1.0 --radius2 0.1 --depth 1.0 --location 0 0 0.95
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name Mid --vertices 7 --radius1 0.78 --radius2 0.05 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 1.5 --rotation 0 0 25
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name Tip --vertices 7 --radius1 0.52 --radius2 0 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 2.05 --rotation 0 0 50
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name SnowLow --vertices 7 --radius1 0.66 --radius2 0.06 --depth 0.55 --location 0 0 1.2
material assign Snow
add mesh cone --name SnowMid --vertices 7 --radius1 0.52 --radius2 0.03 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 1.72 --rotation 0 0 25
material assign Snow
add mesh cone --name SnowTip --vertices 7 --radius1 0.34 --radius2 0 --depth 0.46 --location 0 0 2.23 --rotation 0 0 50
material assign Snow
select all
shade flat
export pine.glb
